card.name: Digits and letters before unit abbreviations
card.fires_on: A single character inside a number or word where a unit such as mg/m2 or mm comes next, or the W in "see Warnings" cross-references. It also fires on odd letters inside garbled headings like ADMINISTRATION.

modes.label: Digit inside a dose number
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a number just before a unit like mg/m 2 or mm.

modes.label: Garbled heading letter
modes.description: A stray letter inside a misspelled section heading.

card.writes: It suppresses short unit-like tokens such as dm, mt, ms and nm, so it holds back a unit right after the character.
card.plain: It marks a spot in the middle of a number or word where a unit or the rest of the word is not yet due.
